data.description: As a full-round action, a Vetala can attempt to take control of a helpless living creature's body, as the spell Magic Jar (caster level 10th or the Vetala's Hit Dice, whichever is higher), except that it does not require a receptacle. The target can resist the attack with a successful Will save (DC %1).
data.name: Malevolence
